tool_input.description: Show uncommitted changes and new teams feature files

result:
The success notification now lives in the mutation hook, and the component no longer calls `useNotifications`. I didn't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked.

- **`apps/react-vite/src/features/teams/api/update-team.ts`**: `useUpdateTeam` imports `useNotifications` and calls `addNotification({ type: 'success', title: 'Team Renamed' })` in its `onSuccess`, after the teams refetch. It still calls any `onSuccess` passed in through `mutationConfig`.
- **`apps/react-vite/src/features/teams/components/update-team.tsx`**: removed the `useNotifications` import and the `addNotification` call. The component now calls `useUpdateTeam()` with no config.

The existing `create-discussion`, `update-discussion`, `delete-comment` and other components in `features/` still call `useNotifications` in components. I left them alone because they are outside this change, but they break the same rule and could be moved in a separate refactor.
